::: {.intro}

## About me

<img src="images/profile.jpeg"
     alt="Hadrien Oliveri"
     style="width: 90px; height: 90px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; float: left; margin-right: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">

I am an applied mathematician working at the interface of nonlinear mechanics, elasticity, growth, and biological morphogenesis.

My research develops mathematical models for how biological and soft material systems grow, deform, and control their shape.

:::

## Research interests

- Growth and morphogenesis
- Plant mechanics and tissue tension
- Nonlinear elasticity and instabilities
- Biological transport and network models
